mapper.select: SELECT id, trace_id, message, stack, component_stack, context, url, level, user_name, create_time FROM oa_frontend_error_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY create_time, id

SELECT service_name, request_method, request_url, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(slow_flag) AS slow_count, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 2) AS average_duration, MAX(duration_ms) AS maximum_duration FROM sys_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND request_url IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name, request_method, request_url HAVING SUM(slow_flag) > 0
ORDER BY request_count DESC, average_duration DESC ORDER BY average_duration DESC, request_count DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS error_count FROM sys_api_error_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND occur_time >= #{from} AND occur_time < #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
